title: Unpopular opinion: Spyro beats Crash
caption: Unpopular opinion: Spyro beats Crash. Agree or disagree? #spyro #crashbandicoot #playstation #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: Spyro beats Crash.

Spyro lets you explore at your own pace. Crash pushes you down a corridor. Collecting gems with Sparx is relaxing in a way Crash's death traps never were. Crash is harder. Spyro is more fun. Agree?
